stage: Source-reference scoring replay after question binding
design: Post-discovery causal parser/reference ablation using previously selected records and constructed outputs. No model accuracy claim.
output_construction: Freeform reference is first accepted alias. MC reference is correct legal source option letter. WrongMC uses next legal letter, wrongfreeform uses fixed non-answer sentinel. Empty and A remain probes, not assumed zero under official rule mode.
isolation: All conditions receive identical source and constructed response per case. No question change or model generation can account for scorer differences.
predictions: List-valued targets will often be rejected by native choice parser; preserve any accepted counterexamples.
Singleton scalarization can repair MC references but cannot recover free-form semantics or aliases.
Official rule dispatch should preserve both splits and source references; literal alias replays may expose official-rule limitations and must be retained.
official_scope: Execute unchanged pinned official rule helpers. This is the optional official rule mode, not default model-judge mode, full benchmark inference or a leaderboard score.
rng: Dedicated Python random.Random(42) for official MC fallback; count and save every fallback. Fixed ordering selected records then four output families.
denominator_policy: Save nominal cases, valid reference denominator, valid predictions, invalid references, parse/empty outcomes and native reported0.0 separately. Denominator0 is UNSCORABLE. Official fallback guesses remain visible.
provenance: Native preprocessing and _rescore_choice_single method bodies from pinned source with original parser package. AST data-only scaffold, no installed whole engine/model/tokenizer/transport.
exposure: All200records previously observed. Code and docs inspected before this protocol. Not prospective unseen task families.
errors: Retain every selected case, exception, parser failure and mismatching constructed oracle. No resampling or outcome-dependent repairs.
